resources.string: This workspace has servers and plugins that can run commands on your device and reach the network. Only allow the ones you trust.
Unticked ones won\'t run, and won\'t ask again until they change. You can change any of this in Configuration settings.
Anything it adds later, like after a git pull, runs without asking. Handy for scheduled tasks in a project you own.
Servers and plugins can run commands and contact services. Editing instructions or docs never asks again, only changes to what actually runs.
Ask about new and changed tools
Safest. Editing an allowed server or plugin asks again.
Tools you allowed keep running after they change. Good for projects you edit yourself.
Nothing asks. Anything this workspace adds runs right away, including after a git pull.
This workspace\'s servers and plugins never run and nothing asks. Your global servers still work.
Switch one on to let it run. Switching it off remembers your answer, so it won\'t ask again until it changes.
Your setting above decides for every item right now. Your answers here come back if you switch to asking.
Configuration changed. Review it again before allowing anything.
Project tools need approval: %1$s. Open this chat to allow them, or choose how this workspace trusts its tools in Configuration settings.
